reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and a freelancer handles my marketing; an ad full of 'AI co-workers' doesn't show me what this does that those two don't. I might try the free plan out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay 99 € a month on the strength of a LinkedIn ad.
objection: What does this actually do that ChatGPT plus my freelancer don't, and what is a 'credit'? 100 credits a month means nothing to me, so I can't tell if it would replace any of my freelancer's hours or just be one more subscription.
would_change_my_mind: A concrete example from a business my size showing it reliably handled a specific job I currently pay my freelancer for, with a clear idea of how far 100 credits goes.
